svg.title: Developmental Ecology: Experimental Configurations
svg.desc: The Human–AI Pathways Project. Seven configuration dimensions—model, continuity, memory, interaction protocol, tools, interface and embodied context, task—and the experimental cycle from controlled conditions to persistence and transfer tests.
svg.text: THE HUMAN–AI PATHWAYS PROJECT · Human–AI Developmental Research Program
Elements of the developmental ecology that can be systematically configured and compared
